), agg AS (

         sum(CASE WHEN q='Q1' THEN price ELSE 0 END) AS q1_gmv,

), dec AS (
  SELECT * FROM both WHERE diff < 0

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM dec) AS declining_categories,
